description: Dependency corrections bound to exact independently confirmed old/new values and source snapshots. Source metadata is derived from reviewed fields.

changes.newValue: Brownie (PHB p.66): the magic-user gains Dexterity equal to the brownie’s 18, is never surprised, and gains +2 on all saving throws. Pseudo-dragon (MM pp.79–80): a companion shares its 35% magic resistance while touching it; it uses limited telepathy and can convey sight and hearing to its companion within 24″. Imp or quasit familiar (MM pp.54, 80): telepathy shares the familiar’s senses up to one mile; within 1″ the master gains 25% magic resistance and regenerates 1 hit point per melee round. Within one mile the master gains one level of ability; at more than a mile the source says the character loses one level, and if the familiar is killed the character loses four levels. Once a week the familiar can contact a lower plane like commune with six questions.
changes.reason: PHB Find Familiar and its referenced Monster Manual entries directly state these familiar-specific benefits.

changes.newValue: Check each round. The DMG states an Intelligence 12+ minimum, but its spell-user detection table contains lower-Intelligence entries; how these interact is unresolved. For non-spell-users, base chances are fighter 2%, paladin 6%, ranger 4%, thief 6%, assassin 5%, monk 1%, bard 3%; UA adds cavalier 5% and barbarian 1%. Add 1% per experience level and cumulative Intelligence bonuses above 12: 13–18 give +1%, +3%, +6%, +10%, +15%, +21% respectively. Treat monsters as the most applicable class. Spell-users use the detection-of-invisibility table instead.
changes.reason: UA magic mirror directs detection to the DMG crystal-ball rules and adds two base classes; DMG p.141 specifies the procedure.

oldValue: The character is immune to illusions and phantasms.
Once-daily blindness, blur and change self use the highest class level; personal non-detection also applies.
PC deep gnomes do not have psionic abilities under this source.
newValue: The character is immune to illusions and phantasms.
Once-daily blindness, blur and change self use the highest class level; personal non-detection also applies.
PC deep gnomes do not have psionic abilities under this source.

A non-illusionist deep gnome who reaches 6th level in any class can attempt a summon once per day, similar to conjure elemental: roll d20; 1: 24 HD earth elemental; 2–6: 16 HD earth elemental; 7–10: 12 HD earth elemental; 11–15: 8 HD earth elemental; 16–18: xorn; 19–20: failure, with no further attempt that day.
Infravision reaches 12″ and ultravision 3″; bright light reduces all vision to 3″ and imposes −1 to hit opponents in such conditions.
A PC deep gnome is surprised only 1 in 12; it surprises others 9 in 10 when alone or with other deep gnomes and not wearing bulky armor.
Deep underground, it has a 60% chance to camouflage itself against natural rock, remaining effectively invisible until moving, attacking or taking another action that negates invisibility.
In melee against drow and kuo-toa, it gains +1 to hit and damage.
